title: The Heist Where Thieves Stole a Diamond by Replacing the Curator With a Wax Dummy

title: The Cartel That Used a Zoo to Hide a Million-Dollar Grow Operation

title: The Criminal Mastermind Who Escaped Prison by Hiding in a Dead Man's Body Bag

title: The Billion-Dollar Fraud That Sold a Bridge That Was Never Built

title: The White-Collar Criminal Who Stole a Country's Carbon Credits by Faking a Forest

title: The Cartel That Used a Chain of Dentist Offices to Launder Money Through Gold Teeth

title: The Mob That Turned a Funeral Home Into a Full-Service Crime Disposal Business

title: The White-Collar Criminal Who Stole a Hospital's Pharmacy by Faking a Medical License for 20 Years
